name: stillpane
description: Attaches stillpane window captures (screenshot plus full text) to your next Claude Code message. Two hooks, both scoped to ~/.claude/stillpane: a UserPromptSubmit hook that attaches a capture under two minutes old and never reads your prompt, and a PreToolUse hook that pre-approves Read calls inside that folder only. Two skills: /stillpane attaches an older capture; stillpane-install downloads the macOS menu bar app from GitHub releases after you confirm. The plugin makes no other network calls. Requires the stillpane app, macOS 14 or later.
